name: Runemaster Runeslinger procs 20% spell haste for 5s off direct damage (#2727)
contract: Original Runeslinger 705550 rolls a 5 percent chance on any direct damage, with no spell-family
restriction or internal cooldown, and triggers the five-second 20 percent spell-haste aura 520760.
Preserve a normal Primordial Blast hit, then collect 280 funded ordinary Elemental Burst hits. The
original casting-speed-only fixture 50336 supplies an asserted permanent +300 percent modifier so the
large sample fits the six-hundred-second scenario budget; the ordinary casts still complete normally and
respect the native minimum global cooldown. Measure Runeslinger against this baseline, preserving its
additional 20 percent benefit. Costs, base cast times, missile timing, cooldown logic, proc chance and
proc duration remain original. Count a new actual damage event and verify casting/global cooldown
readiness for every trial; submitted casts rejected by the global cooldown are not trials. At least 281
eligible hits bound zero procs by 0.95^281, about 5.5e-7. Check the authored 5 percent chance
statistically, observe the real triggered haste amount and 1/1.2 cast-speed multiplier at temporally
bracketed checkpoints, and verify expiration restores baseline. Never inject the proc aura as a
substitute for observing its actual benefit.
